title: The comparison of direct images on a supplied K-injective representative
statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of ringed spaces with derived categories of module sheaves. Let I be an integer K-injective complex on X, K a derived object, and r:K≅Q(I). Put D=f_*. The hom of topEdgeDirectImageComparison(f,K), followed by the published rightDerivedFunctor.map(r.hom) and rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso(I).hom, equals the recorded sectionDerivedDirectImage.map(r.hom) followed by rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutionsObjIso(identity_I).hom. These are the fixed constructions of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-top-edge] and [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf].

source.place: Tag 01E4, lemma-describe-higher-direct-images, bounded-below-complex local class calculation; Tags 0BKJ and 0D5X

proof.text: Lift r.inv followed by the inverse fixed-resolution isomorphism to a map I→topEdgeResolution(K). Use the naturality of the recorded comparison and the proved source lemma Functor.rightDerivedFunctor_map_Q_map_comp_objQIso_hom for the published comparison. Both compute the same direct-image map of this lift.

That direct-image map is an isomorphism because either comparison equation expresses it between isomorphisms. Cancel it from the two comparison equations, expand the fixed topEdgeDirectImageComparison, and obtain the displayed normalization.

theorem directImage_resolution_normalization
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
    (r : K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) :
    let D := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f
    letI : D.Additive := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage_additive f
    (RingedSpace.topEdgeDirectImageComparison f K).hom ≫
        D.rightDerivedFunctor.map r.hom ≫ (D.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso I).hom =
      (RingedSpace.sectionDerivedDirectImage f).map r.hom ≫
        (D.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutionsObjIso
          (RingedSpace.localSectionsEnoughKInjectives X) (𝟙 I)).hom
